name: @kaynooo/cli-git
description: gst, gc, gb, gp, gf, gm, gcl, gd and gu: a repository's state in one call, a commit of exactly the paths given, its message checked before anything is staged, a branch picked, nested repositories pushed or fetched, a branch merged with its conflicts listed, a clone into the workspace, the changes per file and an undo that keeps what it takes away.
author: Kaynooo <contact@kaynooo.fr>

scripts.build: $npm_execpath build src/gst.ts src/gc.ts src/gb.ts src/gp.ts src/gf.ts src/gm.ts src/gcl.ts src/gd.ts src/gu.ts --root src --target bun --outdir dist
